contract.label: Sheet
contract.summary: A dialog panel that slides in from an edge. A Trigger opens a portalled Content with header/footer, title, description, and close.
contract.purpose: The edge-anchored panel for longer edit flows. 420px on the inline edges by default, full width on mobile.
useWhen: An edit or update form runs to many fields.
A detail panel should keep the page context visible behind it.
dontUseWhen: The form is one to four fields — that is a `dialog`.
The flow is a destructive confirmation — that is an `alert-dialog`.

parts.name: Sheet
parts.description: Root managing the sheet's open state.

parts.name: SheetTrigger
parts.description: Opens the sheet; pass a Button via the render prop.

parts.name: SheetClose
parts.description: Closes the sheet; wrap a Button via the render prop.

parts.name: SheetContent
parts.description: The sliding panel; takes a side prop (default right). 420px wide for left/right, uncapped for top/bottom — resize with a plain sm:max-w-* class, or set the --sheet-width custom property.

parts.name: SheetHeader
parts.description: Top section for the title and description.

parts.name: SheetDescription
parts.description: Muted supporting text under the title.

forbids: Widening past the default unless the content genuinely needs it — and then through the `--sheet-width` custom property the primitive reads, not a `w-*` override.
rules: Default width 420px, full-width on mobile. Keeps its top-right close (X).

requirements: Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close.

antiPatterns: A sheet used as a permanent side panel — it is an overlay, mounted at the app root.
